{{Top|leg}}
'''Enzymatic acid''' was a type of [[Acid/Legends|acid]] used in [[biotic vat]]s. The acid was capable of breaking down organic refuse into its component cellular nutrients, creating a rich organic soup that could be used for recycling purposes.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
